summary: Batch renders single characters at fixed 2-row grid positions. After nested guards on the format context (this+0xC) and display context (this+0x14) and on a non-zero sub-field at offset +84 of the display context, it reads eleven indexed character-source globals (each with a small decimal offset), formats each into a local buffer as a "%c" via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, and places each character at a fixed (x, row) position through sub_553070. Row 0 holds seven characters at x=0..210 (row 11); row 1 holds five characters at x=20..188 (row 65). Returns the result of the final sub_553070 call.
